title: Group Room Blocks Clause: Cancellation of a Definite Contract
content:
**C.1 Counting the days.** For a Group Room Blocks cancellation, days are counted as whole calendar days from the notice date to the arrival date.

**C.2 Elimination waiver.** Where the block type carries the elimination waiver and the notice is received within the block type's elimination notice hours of the team's elimination from its tournament, no damages are charged and every deposit is refunded. The elimination is shown by the tournament's published results, which the organiser provides.

**C.3 Deposits.** Deposits held are retained toward the damages under the deposit rules.

**C.4 Status and once only.** Damages are charged only on a block whose status is cancelled, at most once.

**C.5 Lapsed proposals.** A tentative block that lapses carries no damages.

**C.6 Anticipated room revenue.** The anticipated room revenue of a block is its contracted room nights times the group rate.

**Retired wording, kept for the record.**
- "The organiser cancels a definite contract only by signing a written cancellation notice when the block type requires written notice; a cancellation request by phone is taken as the start of that notice and has no effect until it is signed." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis for signing a cancellation.
- "Cancellation damages are the contracted room nights times the group rate times the scale percentage for the number of calendar days between the date the signed notice is received and the arrival date, rounded to the cent." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis of the cancellation damages.
- "the first step of the cancellation scale, read from the top, whose days-from figure is not greater than that count applies." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis of the cancellation damages.

### Elimination waiver combinations

| Block type carries the waiver | Notice received within the elimination notice hours | Published results provided by the organiser | Outcome under C.2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | no damages; every deposit refunded |
| Yes | No | — | C.2 does not apply |
| No | — | — | C.2 does not apply |

### Day count (hypothetical dates)

A notice received on 10 March for an arrival on 20 March counts 10 whole calendar days.
